bigIdea: A protected lane on Harmon Avenue can end the crashes at Harmon and 9th for less than the city spends each year cleaning up after them.

beats.name: What Is
beats.claim: Harmon and 9th is the most dangerous crossing in the city, and it is getting worse.

beats.name: What Could Be
beats.claim: A street where a twelve-year-old can ride to school is possible on Harmon now.

beats.name: Return
beats.claim: Parking and cost are real concerns, and both are smaller than they look.

beats.name: Bridge
beats.claim: A twelve-week pilot with paint and posts shows the result before the city pays for concrete.

beats.name: Commit
beats.claim: Vote Tuesday to fund the pilot, and judge it on the crash count in July.
